results.name: depth.adversarial.runtimeCeilings
results.note: Node's JSON.parse is iterative and does NOT bound nesting depth — it parsed every depth attempted. A naive RECURSIVE traversal overflows the stack far earlier. AION must impose its own depth limit; the runtime will not do it, and the limit must protect the traversal, not the parse.
